source_refs.note: Roman Urdu: practice short questions written from Chapter 2 (PDF 22-45), not printed in the book; same questions and order as the English set. Drafts needing academic review.

blocks.text: Yeh chapter 2 (Atomic Structure) ke poore chapter se practice short questions (mukhtasar sawal) hain, chapter ke sections ki tarteeb mein, Board ke 2 number wale sawal ke andaz mein. Har sawal ka mukhtasar model jawab hai; chhote numericals mein hal ke qadam hain, aur farq wale sawal ka jawab table mein hai.
2.1 Atomic number, proton number and nucleon number; identity of an element

blocks.prompt:
1 What did Moseley observe in 1913, and what did he conclude about the atomic number?
(Moseley ne 1913 mein kya dekha, aur atomic number ke bare mein kya nateeja nikala?)
blocks.explanation: Jab elements par cathode rays dali gayin to khaas frequency ki X-rays paida huin; √(frequency) ∝ Z. Nateeja: atomic number Z element ki bunyadi khasiyat hai. Ise proton number bhi kehte hain.

book_ref.quote: the square root of the frequency of the X-rays was directly proportional to the atomic number

blocks.prompt:
2 Define nucleon number and write its relation with atomic number and the number of neutrons.
(Nucleon number ki definition likhein aur atomic number aur neutrons ki tadaad se is ka taluq likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Atom ke nucleus mein protons aur neutrons ki kul tadaad nucleon number (A) hai, ise mass number bhi kehte hain. A = Z + N, is liye N = A − Z.

book_ref.quote: collectively called its nucleon number (A), also called mass number

blocks.prompt:
3 Calculate the numbers of protons, neutrons and electrons in ²³₁₁Na⁺.
(²³₁₁Na⁺ mein protons, neutrons aur electrons ki tadaad nikalein.)
blocks.explanation: Protons = Z = 11. Neutrons = A − Z = 23 − 11 = 12. Na aik electron khota hai: electrons = 11 − 1 = 10.

book_ref.quote: the number of electrons, protons, and neutrons can be justified for an ion

blocks.prompt:
4 Show that ¹⁶₈O²⁻ and ¹⁹₉F⁻ have the same number of electrons but different numbers of neutrons.
(Dikhayein ke ¹⁶₈O²⁻ aur ¹⁹₉F⁻ mein electrons barabar magar neutrons mukhtalif hain.)
blocks.explanation: O²⁻: electrons = 8 + 2 = 10; neutrons = 16 − 8 = 8. F⁻: electrons = 9 + 1 = 10; neutrons = 19 − 9 = 10. Dono mein 10 electrons; neutrons 8 aur 10 hain.

book_ref.quote: In case electron gain happens by the neutral atoms

blocks.prompt:
5 An atom of ²⁴₁₂Mg forms Mg²⁺. Which of the numbers of protons, neutrons and electrons change? Give the values.
(²⁴₁₂Mg ka atom Mg²⁺ banata hai. Protons, neutrons aur electrons mein se kaun si tadaad badalti hai? Qeematein dein.)
blocks.explanation: Sirf electrons badalte hain. Protons = 12 aur neutrons = 24 − 12 = 12 wahi rehte hain; electrons = 12 − 2 = 10.

book_ref.quote: atom loses three electrons to form Al³⁺

blocks.prompt:
6 Differentiate between atomic number and mass number.
(Atomic number aur mass number mein farq likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Atomic number sirf protons ginta hai; mass number protons aur neutrons dono.

book_ref.quote: Thus the atomic number and proton number represent the same concept.

rows: Nucleus mein protons aur neutrons ki tadaad
Ise proton number bhi kehte hain
Ise nucleon number bhi kehte hain
Element ke har atom ke liye aik hi; bunyadi khasiyat

blocks.text: 2.2 Effect of an electric field on the fundamental particles

blocks.prompt:
7 How do beams of electrons, protons and neutrons behave when passed at the same speed through an electric field?
(Electrons, protons aur neutrons ki beams aik hi speed se electric field se guzaari jayen to un ka rawaiyya kya hota hai?)
blocks.explanation: Neutrons neutral hain, nahi mudte aur seedhe jate hain. Protons (positive) negative plate ki taraf mudte hain. Electrons (negative) positive plate ki taraf mudte hain, aur ziyada, kyunke un ka mass proton ka 1/1836 hai.

book_ref.quote: If we allow the beams of electrons, protons and neutrons to pass one by one at the same speed

blocks.prompt:
8 Why are electrons deflected more than protons in an electric field?
(Electric field mein electrons protons se ziyada kyun mudte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Angle of deflection ∝ charge/mass. Electron aur proton ka charge barabar miqdaar ka hai, magar electron ka mass proton ka sirf 1/1836 hai, is liye us ka charge/mass bohat ziyada hai aur woh ziyada mudta hai.

book_ref.quote: to greater extent since they are 1/1836 times lighter than protons

blocks.prompt:
9 Differentiate between the angle of deflection and the radius of deflection of a particle in an electric field.
(Electric field mein zarre ke angle of deflection aur radius of deflection mein farq likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Angle of deflection charge/mass par aur radius of deflection mass/charge par munhasir hai.

book_ref.quote: the factors affecting the radius of deflection are reciprocal to that for the angle of deflection

rows: Asal simt se inhiraf (deviation) ko angle se naapta hai
Zarre ko gol raste par chalta maan kar inhiraf naapta hai

blocks.prompt:
10 Calculate the charge-to-mass ratio (e/m) of a proton from the values in Table 2.2.
(Table 2.2 ki qeematon se proton ka charge/mass ratio (e/m) nikalein.)

book_ref.quote: Table 2.2 Properties of three fundamental particles

blocks.prompt:
11 Using the masses in amu from Table 2.2, show that a proton is about 1836 times heavier than an electron.
(Table 2.2 ke amu wale masses se dikhayein ke proton electron se taqreeban 1836 guna bhaari hai.)
blocks.explanation: Proton ka mass/electron ka mass = 1.0073 amu / 5.4858 × 10⁻⁴ amu = 1836. Yani electron ka mass proton ka 1/1836 hai.

book_ref.quote: shows the properties of three fundamental particles electron, proton and neutron present in an atom

blocks.text: 2.3 Experimental evidence for the electronic configuration

blocks.prompt:
12 From which model does the modern theory of electronic structure originate, and what are the two main sources of evidence for it?
(Electronic structure ka modern nazariya kis model se shuru hota hai, aur is ke saboot ke do bare zaraye kaun se hain?)
blocks.explanation: Yeh atom ke Bohr model se shuru hota hai. Is aur baad ke models ka saboot ziyada tar (i) atomic spectra aur (ii) ionization energies se milta hai.

book_ref.quote: derives principally from two sources; atomic spectra and ionization energies

blocks.prompt:
13 What is an atomic emission spectrum?
(Atomic emission spectrum kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Jab gas halat ka element bohat garam kiya jaye ya us mein electrical discharge guzara jaye to woh khaas wavelengths ki radiation kharij karta hai. Is radiation ke spectrum mein rangeen lakeerein hoti hain; ise atomic emission spectrum kehte hain.

book_ref.quote: The spectrum of this radiation contains coloured lines and is called atomic emission spectrum.

blocks.prompt:
14 Differentiate between atomic emission spectrum and atomic absorption spectrum.
(Atomic emission spectrum aur atomic absorption spectrum mein farq likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Emission garam ya excited gas se rangeen lakeerein deta hai; absorption white light mein thandi gas se kaali lakeerein.

book_ref.quote: When a beam of white light is passed through a gaseous sample of an element in cold state, certain wavelengths are absorbed.

rows: Gas element ko bohat garam kiya jata hai ya electrical discharge guzara jata hai
White light thande gas element se guzari jati hai
Element ki khaas wavelengths par lakeerein
Kaali lakeerein bilkul emission wali wavelengths par

blocks.prompt:
15 Why are atomic spectra called the finger prints of the elements?
(Atomic spectra ko elements ke finger prints kyun kehte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Har element ki electrons ki tarteeb munfarid hai, is liye us ke muqarrar energy levels bhi munfarid hain. Electrons ke in levels ke darmiyan jump se kharij ya jazb hone wali wavelengths bhi munfarid hoti hain, is liye har element ka apna khaas spectrum hai jis se use pehchana jata hai.

book_ref.quote: atomic spectra are the finger prints of the elements

blocks.prompt:
16 Why do the dark lines of the absorption spectrum of an element lie at the same wavelengths as the coloured lines of its emission spectrum?
(Kisi element ke absorption spectrum ki kaali lakeerein us ke emission spectrum ki rangeen lakeeron ki wavelengths par hi kyun hoti hain?)
blocks.explanation: Dono usi element ke unhi muqarrar energy levels ke darmiyan electrons ke jump se bante hain. Ooper jump ke liye jazb hone wali energy usi jump ke neeche aane par kharij hone wali energy ke barabar hai, is liye wavelengths bilkul wahi hain.

book_ref.quote: the wavelengths and frequencies of the radiation absorbed or emitted when electrons jump from one energy level to another

blocks.text: 2.3.2 Relation between ionization energy and energy levels (electronic shells)

blocks.prompt:
17 What are successive ionization energies? Write the equations for the first three.
(Successive ionization energies kya hain? Pehli teen ki equations likhein.)
blocks.explanation:
Atom ke electrons aik aik kar ke nikalne ke liye darkaar energies, yahan tak ke sirf nucleus bache.
X → X⁺ + e⁻ (ΔHᵢ₁)
X⁺ → X²⁺ + e⁻ (ΔHᵢ₂)
X²⁺ → X³⁺ + e⁻ (ΔHᵢ₃)

book_ref.quote: We call this sequence of ionization energies, successive ionization energies.

blocks.prompt:
18 Why is the jump on removing the eleventh electron of magnesium even larger than the jump on removing its third electron?
(Magnesium ka gyarahvan electron nikalne par jump us ke teesre electron wale jump se bhi bara kyun hai?)
blocks.explanation: Teesra electron doosre shell se nikalne wala pehla electron hai. Gyarahvan electron pehle, sab se andar wale shell se, nucleus ke bilkul qareeb se nikalta hai jahan woh kahin ziyada mazbooti se pakra hota hai. Is liye yeh jump kahin bara hai.

book_ref.quote: A similar but much more enormous jump occurs when the eleventh and twelfth electrons are removed.

blocks.prompt:
19 Why are all ionization energies endothermic?
(Tamam ionization energies endothermic kyun hain?)
blocks.explanation: Electron nucleus ki taraf khincha hota hai, is liye use atom se alag karne ke liye energy deni parti hai. Is liye har ionization energy jazb karti hai; ionization energies strongly endothermic hain.

book_ref.quote: All ionization energies are strongly endothermic

blocks.prompt:
20 Arrange lithium, sodium and potassium in order of decreasing first ionization energy and give the reason.
(Lithium, sodium aur potassium ko ghatti hui first ionization energy ki tarteeb mein likhein aur wajah batayein.)
blocks.explanation: Li > Na > K. Group mein neeche shells barhte hain, atom bara hota hai aur nucleus ki valence electron par giraft kam hoti hai, is liye electron nikalna asaan hota hai.

book_ref.quote: down the group, number of shells increases, hold of nucleus on the valence electrons decreases

blocks.prompt:
21 Why does ionization energy generally increase across a period?
(Period mein baayen se daayen ionization energy aam tor par kyun barhti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Period mein shell number wahi rehta hai. Proton number barhta hai jabke electrons usi shell mein aate hain, is liye nucleus valence electrons ko ziyada mazbooti se khenchta hai aur ionization energy barhti hai.

book_ref.quote: As the proton number increases, electrons are added in the same shell.

blocks.prompt:
22 The first four ionization energies of an element are 801, 2427, 3660 and 25026 kJ mol⁻¹. How many valence electrons does it have?
(Aik element ki pehli chaar ionization energies 801, 2427, 3660 aur 25026 kJ mol⁻¹ hain. Is ke kitne valence electrons hain?)
blocks.explanation: Izafe: 2427 − 801 = 1626; 3660 − 2427 = 1233; 25026 − 3660 = 21366 kJ mol⁻¹ (ΔHᵢ₄/ΔHᵢ₃ = 6.8). Bara jump teesre electron ke baad hai, is liye chautha andar ke shell se nikalta hai: element ke 3 valence electrons hain (group 13).

book_ref.quote: The successive ionization energies show clearly the arrangement of electrons in shells around the nucleus.

blocks.prompt:
23 Why does Schrödinger's model need three quantum numbers to describe orbitals, while the Bohr model used only one?
(Schrödinger ke model ko orbitals bayan karne ke liye teen quantum numbers kyun chahiye, jabke Bohr model sirf aik istemal karta tha?)
blocks.explanation: Bohr model one-dimensional tha; sirf orbit ka size aur energy aham thi, jo n batata tha. Schrödinger ka model electron ko teen simti space deta hai, jis ke liye teen coordinates yani teen quantum numbers n, ℓ aur m (size, shape, orientation) chahiye.

book_ref.quote: Since Schrodinger’s model allowed the electron to occupy three-dimensional space

blocks.prompt:
24 What does the principal quantum number describe? What is the effect of increasing n?
(Principal quantum number kya batata hai? n barhane ka kya asar hai?)
blocks.explanation: n (1, 2, 3, … = K, L, M, …) orbital ka size aur energy batata hai. n jitna bara, electron ka nucleus se ausat faasla utna ziyada (bara orbital) aur energy utni ziyada, is liye woh nucleus se kam mazbooti se bandha hota hai.

book_ref.quote: The larger ‘n’ is, the greater the average distance of an electron in the orbital from the nucleus

blocks.prompt:
25 Define an electron shell. Calculate the maximum number of electrons in the shells with n = 5 and n = 6.
(Electron shell ki definition likhein. n = 5 aur n = 6 wale shells mein ziyada se ziyada electrons nikalein.)
blocks.explanation: Aik hi n qeemat wale orbitals ka majmua electron shell hai. Ziyada se ziyada electrons = 2n²: n = 5 ke liye 2 × 25 = 50; n = 6 ke liye 2 × 36 = 72.

book_ref.quote: maximum number of electrons in a shell by the formula 2n²

blocks.prompt:
26 Define a subshell. Give the values of ℓ and the subshells for n = 4.
(Subshell ki definition likhein. n = 4 ke liye ℓ ki qeematein aur subshells batayein.)
blocks.explanation: Aik jaise n aur ℓ wale orbitals ka set subshell hai. n = 4 ke liye ℓ = 0, 1, 2, 3, yani 4s, 4p, 4d aur 4f subshells (chaar subshells, shell number ke barabar).

book_ref.quote: The set of orbitals that have the same n and ℓ values is called a subshell.

blocks.prompt:
27 Why is there no 2d subshell?
(2d subshell kyun nahi hota?)
blocks.explanation: ℓ ki qeematein sirf 0 se (n − 1) tak hoti hain. n = 2 ke liye ℓ sirf 0 ya 1 (2s aur 2p). d subshell ke liye ℓ = 2 chahiye jo sirf n = 3 ya ziyada par mumkin hai.

book_ref.quote: can have integral values 0 to (n- 1) for each value of n

blocks.prompt:
28 Using the formula 2(2ℓ + 1), calculate the maximum number of electrons in the p and f subshells.
(Formula 2(2ℓ + 1) se p aur f subshells mein ziyada se ziyada electrons nikalein.)
blocks.explanation: p subshell: ℓ = 1, 2(2 × 1 + 1) = 6 electrons. f subshell: ℓ = 3, 2(2 × 3 + 1) = 14 electrons.

book_ref.quote: The number of electrons in a subshell can be calculated by the formula 2(2ℓ+1)

blocks.prompt:
29 Differentiate between an electron shell and a subshell.
(Electron shell aur subshell mein farq likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Shell sirf n se tay hota hai; subshell n aur ℓ dono se.

book_ref.quote: These are the spectral terms used to describe certain features of spectral lines.

rows: Aik hi n qeemat wale orbitals ka majmua
Aik jaise n aur ℓ wale orbitals ka set
Principal quantum number n se bayan hota hai
n aur azimuthal quantum number ℓ dono se bayan hota hai

blocks.prompt:
30 Write the values of the magnetic quantum number for ℓ = 3. How many orbitals does this subshell have?
(ℓ = 3 ke liye magnetic quantum number ki qeematein likhein. Is subshell mein kitne orbitals hain?)
blocks.explanation: m ki (2ℓ + 1) qeematein −ℓ se +ℓ tak: −3, −2, −1, 0, +1, +2, +3. Yeh saat qeematein batati hain ke f subshell mein 7 orbitals hain.

book_ref.quote: The magnetic quantum number ‘m’ describes the orientation of an orbital in space.

blocks.prompt:
31 What are degenerate orbitals? Why is m called the magnetic quantum number?
(Degenerate orbitals kya hain? m ko magnetic quantum number kyun kehte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Aik hi subshell ke orbitals ki energy barabar hoti hai; yeh degenerate orbitals hain (maslan teen 2p orbitals). Yeh sirf magnetic field ki mojoodgi mein aik doosre se alag pehchane jate hain, is liye naam magnetic quantum number hai.

book_ref.quote: Orbitals of the same subshell have same energy and are called degenerate orbitals.

blocks.prompt:
32 Why does a d subshell have five orbitals?
(d subshell mein paanch orbitals kyun hote hain?)
blocks.explanation: d subshell ke liye ℓ = 2 hai, aur m ki (2ℓ + 1) = 5 qeematein hain: −2, −1, 0, +1, +2. m ki qeematein orbitals ki tadaad batati hain, is liye d subshell mein 5 orbitals hain.

book_ref.quote: If ℓ=2, (d-subshell), there are five values of m

blocks.prompt:
33 Why does an electron behave like a magnet? What are the values of the spin quantum number?
(Electron magnet ki tarah kyun bartao karta hai? Spin quantum number ki qeematein kya hain?)
blocks.explanation: Electron apne mehwar (axis) par ghoomta hai, aur ghoomta charge magnetic field paida karta hai, is liye woh magnet jaisa hai. Spin clockwise (s = +½, ↑) ya anticlockwise (s = −½, ↓) ho sakta hai.

book_ref.quote: It is this motion that causes an electron to behave like a magnet.

blocks.prompt:
34 Why is a fourth quantum number needed when three quantum numbers already describe an orbital?
(Jab teen quantum numbers orbital ko bayan kar dete hain to chauthe quantum number ki zaroorat kyun hai?)
blocks.explanation: Aik orbital mein do electrons aa sakte hain jin ke n, ℓ aur m aik jaise hote hain. In do electrons mein farq karne ke liye spin quantum number s (+½ ya −½) chahiye.

book_ref.quote: Thus it takes three quantum numbers to describe an orbital

blocks.prompt:
35 Show that the shell with n = 3 has 3 subshells, 9 orbitals and at most 18 electrons.
(Dikhayein ke n = 3 wale shell mein 3 subshells, 9 orbitals aur ziyada se ziyada 18 electrons hain.)
blocks.explanation: Subshells = n = 3 (3s, 3p, 3d). Orbitals = 1 + 3 + 5 = 9 = n². Electrons = har orbital mein 2 = 2 × 9 = 18 = 2n².

book_ref.quote: there are n subshells consisting of n² orbitals with a maximum number of 2n² electrons

blocks.prompt:
36 Define an atomic orbital.
(Atomic orbital ki definition likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Atomic orbital nucleus ke gird space ka woh teen simti ilaqa hai jahan electron ke milne ka imkaan (probability) sab se ziyada ho.

book_ref.quote: the three dimensional region in space around the nucleus in which the probability of finding the electron is maximum

blocks.prompt:
37 Describe the shape of an s orbital. How does its size change with n?
(s orbital ki shakal bayan karein. n ke saath is ka size kaise badalta hai?)
blocks.explanation: s orbital gol (spherical) hai; nucleus ke gird electron density har simt mein yaksaan hai. Principal quantum number barhne se s orbital bara hota hai (2s 1s se bara hai).

book_ref.quote: With the increase in the principal quantum number, the size of s orbital also becomes larger.

blocks.prompt:
38 Differentiate between an s orbital and a p orbital.
(s orbital aur p orbital mein farq likhein.)
blocks.explanation: s orbital gol hai; p orbital ke aik axis par do lobes hain.

book_ref.quote: The electron density is not distributed in a spherically symmetric fashion as in an s orbital.

rows: Electron density har simt mein yaksaan
Teen p orbitals px, py, pz (m = −1, 0, +1)

blocks.prompt:
39 Describe the orientations of the five d orbitals.
(Paanch d orbitals ke rukh (orientations) bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation: dxy, dxz aur dyz tarteeb se xy, xz aur yz planes mein hain. dx²−y² ke lobes x aur y axes par hain. dz² ke do lobes z-axis par aur xy plane mein aik doughnut hai.

book_ref.quote: In a given shell, ‘d’ orbitals have different shapes and orientations in space.

blocks.prompt:
40 How many f orbitals are there in an f subshell, and what does the chapter say about their shapes?
(f subshell mein kitne f orbitals hain, aur chapter un ki shakal ke bare mein kya kehta hai?)
blocks.explanation: f subshell (ℓ = 3) ke space mein saat rukh hain, is liye saat f orbitals hain (m = −3 se +3). Un ki shakalein bohat pecheeda hain.

book_ref.quote: An f subshell has seven orientations in space, i.e. there are seven f orbitals.

blocks.prompt:
41 Define electronic configuration. What does the notation 3p⁴ mean?
(Electronic configuration ki definition likhein. Notation 3p⁴ ka kya matlab hai?)
blocks.explanation: Electronic configuration atom ya ion ke shells, subshells ya orbitals mein electrons ki taqseem hai. 3p⁴ mein 3 shell, p subshell aur superscript 4 us subshell mein electrons ki tadaad hai.

book_ref.quote: Each symbol has a superscript on the right.

blocks.prompt:
42 How are electrons shown in an orbital diagram? Write the subshell configuration of ¹⁹₉F.
(Orbital diagram mein electrons kaise dikhaye jate hain? ¹⁹₉F ki subshell configuration likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Orbitals ke har group par subshell notation likha jata hai aur har electron arrow se dikhaya jata hai: s = +½ ke liye ooper, s = −½ ke liye neeche. F (9 electrons): 1s² 2s² 2p⁵.

book_ref.quote: An electron in an orbital is shown by an arrow.

blocks.prompt:
43 Give the maximum electron capacities of the K, L, M and N shells and the orbitals each contains.
(K, L, M aur N shells ki electrons ki ziyada se ziyada gunjaish aur har aik ke orbitals batayein.)
blocks.explanation: K (n = 1): 2, 1s mein. L (n = 2): 8, 2s aur 2p mein. M (n = 3): 18, 3s, 3p aur 3d mein. N (n = 4): 32, 4s, 4p, 4d aur 4f mein.

book_ref.quote: The shells, denoted as K, L, M, N, and so on, correspond to the principal quantum number (n) of the orbitals.

blocks.text: 2.7.2 Distribution of electrons in subshells and orbitals: the Aufbau principle

blocks.prompt:
44 State the Aufbau principle.
(Aufbau principle bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation: Aufbau (building up) principle kehta hai ke atom ke subshells energy ki barhti tarteeb mein electrons se bharte hain; yeh tarteeb (n + ℓ) qeematon se maloom hoti hai.

book_ref.quote: the subshells in an atom are filled with electrons in an increasing order of their energy values

blocks.prompt:
45 State the (n + ℓ) rule. Which is filled first, 6s or 4f?
((n + ℓ) rule bayan karein. Pehle kaun sa bharta hai, 6s ya 4f?)
blocks.explanation: Kam (n + ℓ) wale subshell ki energy kam hoti hai aur woh pehle bharta hai; (n + ℓ) barabar ho to kam n wala pehle. 6s: 6 + 0 = 6; 4f: 4 + 3 = 7. Is liye 6s 4f se pehle bharta hai.

book_ref.quote: The subshell having lower (n + ℓ) value has lower energy and is filled first.

blocks.prompt:
46 Calculate (n + ℓ) for 4d, 5p and 6s and arrange them in the order of filling.
(4d, 5p aur 6s ke liye (n + ℓ) nikalein aur unhein bharne ki tarteeb mein likhein.)
blocks.explanation: 4d: 4 + 2 = 6; 5p: 5 + 1 = 6; 6s: 6 + 0 = 6. Sab barabar, is liye kam n pehle: 4d < 5p < 6s.

book_ref.quote: then the subshell with lower

blocks.text: Pauli's exclusion principle (printed as a second 2.7.2)

blocks.prompt:
47 State Pauli's exclusion principle.
(Pauli's exclusion principle bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation: Atom mein koi do electrons chaaron quantum numbers ki aik jaisi qeematein nahi rakh sakte; yani aik orbital ke do electrons ke spin hamesha mukhalif hote hain.

book_ref.quote: No two electrons in an atom can have the same values for all the four quantum numbers

blocks.prompt:
48 Write the four quantum numbers of the two electrons in the 3s orbital of magnesium.
(Magnesium ke 3s orbital ke do electrons ke chaaron quantum numbers likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Electron 1: n = 3, ℓ = 0, m = 0, s = +½. Electron 2: n = 3, ℓ = 0, m = 0, s = −½. Sirf spin mein farq hai.

book_ref.quote: The two electrons having the same values of

blocks.prompt:
49 Why can an orbital not hold three electrons?
(Aik orbital mein teen electrons kyun nahi aa sakte?)
blocks.explanation: Aik orbital ke sab electrons ke n, ℓ aur m aik jaise hain. Spin s ki sirf do qeematein hain, +½ aur −½, is liye teesre electron ke chaaron quantum numbers kisi pehle wale jaise ho jayenge, jo Pauli ka usool mana karta hai.

book_ref.quote: Two electrons in an orbital will always have opposite spins

blocks.prompt:
50 State Hund's rule and use it to explain the number of unpaired electrons in a nitrogen atom (1s² 2s² 2p³).
(Hund's rule bayan karein aur is se nitrogen atom (1s² 2s² 2p³) ke unpaired electrons ki tadaad samjhayein.)
blocks.explanation: Jab degenerate orbitals mojood hon to electrons aik hi orbital mein mukhalif spin se jaane ke bajaye alag alag orbitals mein aik jaise spin se jate hain. Is liye nitrogen ke teen 2p electrons 2px, 2py aur 2pz mein aik aik, aik jaise spin se: 3 unpaired electrons.

book_ref.quote: they should be placed in separate orbitals with the same spin rather than in the same orbital with opposite spins

blocks.prompt:
51 Why do electrons occupy separate orbitals of the same subshell wherever possible?
(Electrons jahan mumkin ho aik hi subshell ke alag alag orbitals mein kyun jate hain?)
blocks.explanation: Aik hi jagah ke electrons aik jaisa charge hone ki wajah se aik doosre ko dhakelte hain. Alag orbitals (aik jaise spin ke saath) mein jaane se yeh repulsion kam hoti hai; joda tab hi banta hai jab subshell mein koi khali orbital na bache.

book_ref.quote: Electrons in the same region of space repel each other because they have the same charge.

blocks.prompt:
52 Write the configuration of manganese (Z = 25) from Table 2.7 and find the number of unpaired electrons in it.
(Table 2.7 se manganese (Z = 25) ki configuration likhein aur is ke unpaired electrons ki tadaad nikalein.)
blocks.explanation: Mn: 1s²2s²2p⁶3s²3p⁶3d⁵4s². Paanch 3d electrons paanch 3d orbitals mein aik aik, aik jaise spin se; baaqi subshells bhare hain. Unpaired electrons = 5.

book_ref.quote: Electrons are only paired when there are no more empty orbitals available within a subshell.

blocks.prompt:
53 Identify the element with configuration 1s²2s²2p⁶3s²3p⁶3d¹⁰4s²4p⁵ and state its atomic number.
(Configuration 1s²2s²2p⁶3s²3p⁶3d¹⁰4s²4p⁵ wala element pehchanein aur us ka atomic number batayein.)
blocks.explanation: Electrons = 2 + 2 + 6 + 2 + 6 + 10 + 2 + 5 = 35, is liye Z = 35: bromine (Br), jaise Table 2.7 mein.

book_ref.quote: Electronic configuration of ground states of elements

blocks.text: 2.8 Electronic configuration and the periodic table

blocks.prompt:
54 How is the outer configuration of an element related to its group? Give the outer configurations of groups 1, 2 and 13.
(Element ki bahar wali configuration ka us ke group se kya taluq hai? Groups 1, 2 aur 13 ki bahar wali configurations dein.)
blocks.explanation: Periodic table mein aik jaisi bahar wali (valence) configuration wale elements aik hi group mein rakhe gaye hain. Group 1: ns¹; group 2: ns²; group 13: ns²np¹.

book_ref.quote: elements with the same pattern of outer-shell (valence) electron configuration are arranged in same groups

blocks.prompt:
55 Why does the d-block have ten columns and the f-block fourteen columns?
(d-block mein das aur f-block mein chaudah columns kyun hain?)
blocks.explanation: Kisi block ke columns ki tadaad us ke subshell ki electrons ki gunjaish ke barabar hai. d subshell mein 10 aur f subshell mein 14 electrons aate hain, is liye d-block ke 10 aur f-block ke 14 columns hain (isi tarah s: 2, p: 6).

book_ref.quote: Recall that the numbers 2, 6, 10, and 14 are precisely the number of electrons that can fill the s, p, d, and f subshells

blocks.prompt:
56 Define valence electrons. Why do elements of the same group show similar chemical properties?
(Valence electrons ki definition likhein. Aik group ke elements ki chemical properties aik jaisi kyun hoti hain?)
blocks.explanation: Valence electrons atom ke sab se bahar wale shell ke electrons hain; yahi chemical reactions mein hissa lete hain. Aik group ke elements ki valence configurations aik jaisi hain, is liye un ki chemical properties bhi aik jaisi hain.

book_ref.quote: These are such electrons that are primarily involved in chemical reactions.

blocks.text: 2.8.2 Classification of the elements of the periodic table

blocks.prompt:
57 Differentiate between representative elements and transition elements on the basis of electronic configuration.
(Electronic configuration ki buniyaad par representative elements aur transition elements mein farq likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Representative elements bahar wala s ya p subshell bharte hain; transition elements d subshell.

book_ref.quote: Similarly, in the d-block transition elements, a ‘d’ subshell is being filled.

rows: d subshell bhar raha hota hai
Bahar wala s ya p subshell bhar raha hai

blocks.prompt:
58 Which subshell is being filled in each of the four coloured areas of Figure 2.16?
(Figure 2.16 ke chaar rangeen hisson mein kaun sa subshell bhar raha hai?)
blocks.explanation: Neela hissa: ns (s-block). Hara hissa: np (p-block). Peela hissa: (n − 1)d (d-block). Halka sunehra hissa: (n − 2)f (f-block).

book_ref.quote: Figure 2.16 shows a periodic table indicating this pattern.

blocks.prompt:
59 Write the electronic configurations of Mg²⁺ (Z = 12) and O²⁻ (Z = 8). Which noble gas do they resemble?
(Mg²⁺ (Z = 12) aur O²⁻ (Z = 8) ki electronic configurations likhein. Yeh kis noble gas jaisi hain?)
blocks.explanation: Mg²⁺: 12 − 2 = 10 electrons, 1s² 2s² 2p⁶. O²⁻: 8 + 2 = 10 electrons, 1s² 2s² 2p⁶. Dono ki configuration neon jaisi hai.

book_ref.quote: Negative ions are formed when atoms gain electrons.

blocks.prompt:
60 Mn is 1s²2s²2p⁶3s²3p⁶3d⁵4s². Write the configuration of Mn²⁺ and give the reason.
(Mn = 1s²2s²2p⁶3s²3p⁶3d⁵4s². Mn²⁺ ki configuration likhein aur wajah batayein.)
blocks.explanation: Mn²⁺: 1s²2s²2p⁶3s²3p⁶3d⁵. Agarche 4s 3d se pehle bharta hai, d-block atom ion banate waqt pehle 4s ke electrons khota hai.

book_ref.quote: But when atoms of a d-block element lose electrons to form ions, the 4s electrons are lost first.

blocks.prompt:
61 Differentiate between the formation of positive and negative ions with one example each.
(Positive aur negative ions ke banne mein farq likhein, har aik ki aik misaal ke saath.)
blocks.explanation: Positive ion electrons khone se banta hai; negative ion electrons lene se.

book_ref.quote: Positive ions are formed when electrons are removed from atoms.

rows: Atom se electrons nikalne par banta hai
Atom ke electrons lene par banta hai

blocks.prompt:
62 Define a free radical and give three examples.
(Free radical ki definition likhein aur teen misalein dein.)
blocks.explanation: Free radical aisa species hai jis mein aik ya ziyada unpaired electrons hon; inhein nuqte (dot) se dikhate hain. Misalein: chlorine atom Cl•, aur groups OH• aur CH₃•.

book_ref.quote: Apart from single atoms, groups of atoms can also be free radicals.

blocks.prompt:
63 Why is a free chlorine atom a free radical? In which subshell is its unpaired electron?
(Azad chlorine atom free radical kyun hai? Is ka unpaired electron kis subshell mein hai?)
blocks.explanation: Cl: 1s² 2s² 2p⁶ 3s² 3p⁵. 2p subshell poora bhara hai. 3p⁵ mein do orbitals mein jode hain aur teesre mein aik akela electron hai, is liye Cl• free radical hai; unpaired electron 3p subshell mein hai.

book_ref.quote: In the 3p subshell, two orbitals have paired electrons whereas the third one contains a single unpaired electron.

blocks.text: 2.10 Electronic configuration and the formation of semiconductors

blocks.prompt:
64 What are semiconductors? Name two elements that act as semiconductors and two uses.
(Semiconductors kya hain? Do elements batayein jo semiconductors ka kaam karte hain aur do istemal.)
blocks.explanation: Semiconductors aise materials hain jo kuch halaat mein bijli guzar sakte hain. Misalein: silicon aur germanium. Yeh smartphones aur laptops jaise electronic devices mein istemal hote hain.

book_ref.quote: They are used in many electronic devices, including smartphones, laptops, and cars.

blocks.prompt:
65 Why does a pure silicon crystal not conduct electricity?
(Khalis silicon crystal bijli kyun nahi guzarta?)
blocks.explanation: ₁₄Si = 2, 8, 4: is ke 4 valence electrons hain. Khalis crystal mein har Si atom chaar doosre Si atoms se bandha hai, is liye tamam valence electrons bonds mein hain aur electronic conduction mumkin nahi.

book_ref.quote: there is no possibility of electronic conduction through the Si crystal

blocks.prompt:
66 What is doping? Which impurities give P-type and which give N-type semiconductors?
(Doping kya hai? Kaun si impurities P-type aur kaun si N-type semiconductors banati hain?)
blocks.explanation: Khalis semiconductor mein impurity (milawat) atoms milana doping hai. Trivalent impurities (boron, aluminium) se P-type; pentavalent impurities (phosphorus, arsenic) se N-type.

book_ref.quote: P-type and N-type semiconductors are formed by

blocks.prompt:
67 Differentiate between P-type and N-type semiconductors.
(P-type aur N-type semiconductors mein farq likhein.)
blocks.explanation: P-type mein trivalent impurity aur holes; N-type mein pentavalent impurity aur extra electrons.

book_ref.quote: Some of the trivalent atoms take place of the Si atoms in the crystals.

rows: Trivalent impurity (teen valence electrons) se doping, maslan B, Al
Pentavalent impurity (paanch valence electrons) se doping, maslan P, As
Impurity ke qareeb Si atoms chaar bonds nahi bana sakte: holes bante hain
Chaar bonds bante hain aur paanchwan electron extra hota hai

blocks.prompt:
68 How does a P-type semiconductor conduct electricity?
(P-type semiconductor bijli kaise guzarta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Trivalent atoms (maslan Al) kuch Si atoms ki jagah lete hain; electrons ki kami se Si chaar bonds nahi bana pata, is liye holes bante hain jo positive charge carriers hain. Phir bahar ke current source se electrons semiconductor mein harkat kar sakte hain aur woh conductor ka kaam karta hai.

book_ref.quote: Electrons from an external current source can move through the semiconductor

blocks.prompt:
69 In N-type silicon doped with phosphorus, why does the fifth valence electron of phosphorus become free?
(Phosphorus se dope kiye gaye N-type silicon mein phosphorus ka paanchwan valence electron azad kyun ho jata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Phosphorus ke paanch valence electrons hain. Chaar padosi Si atoms ke saath chaar bonds banate hain; paanchwan extra hai jo bond ke liye zaroori nahi, is liye woh harkat ke liye azad hai aur negative charge carrier ka kaam karta hai.

book_ref.quote: These impurity atoms contribute extra electrons to the crystal lattice
